name: Combine two parcellations into a single parcellation
summary: Merges two volumetric parcellations into one with relabelled consecutive values and a combined label.json, resolving overlaps in favour of the first, the second or neither.
description: Reslices the second parcellation onto the first's grid with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol (header-based, nearest neighbour), renumbers the labels of both, sums them and handles overlapping voxels according to the overlap option, then writes parc.nii.gz and label.json. Use it to combine, for example, a cortical and a subcortical atlas. Both parcellations must already be aligned to the same subject space.

inputs.description: First volumetric parcellation with its label.json; defines the output grid.
Second volumetric parcellation with its label.json.
inputs.requirements: Must be aligned with the first; it is resampled by header only.

outputs.description: Combined parcellation (parc.nii.gz) with a merged label.json.

parameters.description: How voxels labelled in both parcellations are resolved: keep the first's label, the second's, or set them to 0.

options.label: first
options.description: use the first input parcellation labels if overlap exists

options.label: second
options.description: use the second input parcellation labels if overlap exists

options.label: remove
options.description: set all overlap voxels to zero

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check the log; parc.nii.gz was not written.
